title: Option for manual inhibition to expire after a time, like DND mode
line: Manually blocking sleep and screen locking can now end by itself after 1 or 4 hours, like Do Not Disturb.
explanation: The Power and Battery applet's "Manually Block Sleep and Screen Locking" switch only had on and off, so the block stayed until the user remembered to turn it off, and the machine never went to sleep after the task was done. Notifications' Do Not Disturb already solves this with a duration menu. Now pressing the switch opens the same kind of menu (For 1 hour, For 4 hours, Until manually unblocked); a timed block shows "Automatically ends at <time>" under the switch and is lifted by itself at that time, with the usual OSD. Middle-click on the tray icon, the global shortcut and the accessibility action still block until unblocked.

commits.message:
applets/batterymonitor: let manual sleep blocking end after a while

Manually blocking sleep and screen locking stayed on until it was turned
off again, so it was easy to forget. Like Do Not Disturb, the switch now
asks for how long to block: 1 hour, 4 hours or until manually unblocked.

BUG: 458095

media.caption: Master: the switch only turns blocking on or off
